title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
Applied AI Engineer - Remote (London) - Up to £100k

We are working alongside an established technology consultancy is seeking a Senior Applied AI Engineer to help design, build and deploy enterprise-scale artificial intelligence solutions.

This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, machine learning, software development and data platforms. You would expected to be working on projects that deliver measurable business outcomes rather than proof-of-concept initiatives.

Working closely with technical and business stakeholders, you'll play a key role in developing AI applications, including GenAI solutions, LLM implementations, RAG and AI-powered decision tools.

Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience delivering AI, machine learning, data science or data engineering solutions.
  • Excellent Python development skills and solid software engineering fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience with generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures, AI agents and workflow automation.
  • Experience building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, model training workflows and cloud-based AI services.
  • Knowledge of MLOps, model monitoring, evaluation frameworks, versioning and deployment practices.
  • Familiarity with modern cloud platforms and enterprise data technologies.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value.

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to join a growing consultancy with a strong focus on innovation, data and AI. You'll work on top AI initiatives across a diverse portfolio of enterprise clients, helping organisations unlock value from emerging technologies while solving complex business challenges.
